about:
Black Diamond Woodworks LLC operates from Bozeman, Montana, serving the Gallatin Valley. The company brings over 30 years of construction and carpentry experience and has been a registered independent contractor for more than 15 years.

The firm provides general contracting and sub-contract carpentry services, including finish carpentry, millwork installation, and lead carpenter support. Its custom woodworking shop produces built-in furniture such as window benches, entertainment centers, hutches, and bookcases, as well as freestanding pieces like conference tables, desks, and chests crafted from barnwood, white oak, reclaimed fir, and aromatic cedar. Additional capabilities cover log work, treehouse design and build, antique repair, and outdoor structures such as pergolas, sheds, and hot tub steps. The company maintains a fully equipped off-site workshop, a service truck, and an equipment shed to support turnkey residential projects.

Clients range from homeowners undertaking kitchen and bath remodels to builders needing specialized carpentry subcontractors. Past projects include a grain-flow white oak sideboard, a reclaimed yellow pine conference table, a D-log re-stack with garage door overlay, and a barnwood exterior door. The company also serves customers seeking custom mantels, hearth pads, and Z-brace doors.

Black Diamond Woodworks distinguishes itself with a choice of cost-plus-percentage-fee or fixed-price bidding, a fully insured operation, and an emphasis on clear communication and organized project management. The team’s deep experience in both structural and finish carpentry allows them to handle projects from initial framing through final millwork installation.
